matter: The bookplate «Ex Libris R. M. Burrell», with the drawing of a turbaned figure seated cross-legged and reading a book; below it, in pencil, the shelfmark «(2) AJB.CA.AA2»; at the foot, a barcode label «22501959681».
A price in pencil, «£170», in the lower middle of the leaf.
L12: «H. SUTER» is underlined in ink by a reader.

In pencil, the shelfmark «(2) AJB.CA.AA2», at mid-height on the left; at the lower left, the round stamp of the Wellcome Institute library, «WELLCOME» above, «LIBRARY» across the middle, «INSTITUTE» below.
A vertical stroke of pencil, about 25 px wide and 330 px long, in the right margin beside L21-L26. Not part of the edition.
A vertical stroke of pencil, about 300 px long, in the right margin beside L37-L38. Not part of the edition.
A stroke of ink through the printed words «ist also» in L36, «der Doppel-Nachtstunde ist also = 35° 52′», drawn by hand over the two words in this copy. Not part of the edition.
A diagonal stroke of ink across «mit» in L15, drawn by hand from above the end of «Zusammenhang» down to the right, in this copy. Not part of the edition.

A stroke of ink through the 2 of «12», the seconds of the moon in the 26 parts (L19), and «16» written in ink in the right margin beside the row, a reader's correction of the value in this copy. Not part of the edition.

A stroke of ink through the printed 0, the sign of the 60 days of the anomaly (L29), and a 1 written in ink before it, a reader's correction of the value in this copy; a small ink stroke in the right margin beside L23. Not part of the edition.

A diagonal stroke of ink through the 5 of «546», the degrees of Virgo 5° (L12), and «/2» written in ink in the left margin beside the row, a reader's correction of the value in this copy. Not part of the edition.
L16: a reader has written in ink a «9» above the 1 of the printed «41» and struck the 1 through with a slanting stroke, correcting the sextile to 49° 11′.

L92: in this copy «16» and «17» of the entry «Deferens» are struck through in ink, each with an oblique stroke; the commas after them and after 60 and the figures 233 and 234 look darker, perhaps gone over in the same ink. Not part of the edition.
The round stamp of the Wellcome Institute library («WELLCOME» above, «LIBRARY» across the middle, «INSTITUTE» below), below the right column at the right, beside the end rule.
A tick in pencil at the upper left.
